ipc.usageText:
Portal command line usage:
  portal --version                        Print the version
  portal -l                               List all instances (grouped by folder type)
  portal search <query> [--type <type>] [--limit <count>]    Search mods, modpacks, resource packs etc. on Modrinth
  portal install vanilla <version> [--folder <folder>] [--id <instance-id>]
  portal install loader <version> --loader <loader[@version]> [--loader ...] [--folder <folder>] [--id <instance-id>]
  portal install modpack <path|link|project-name-or-id> [--from modrinth|curseforge] [--version <version-or-fileId>] [--folder <folder>] [--id <instance-id>]
  portal launch <instance-id> [--folder <folder>] [--world <world-folder>]
  portal launch <instance-id> [--folder <folder>] [--server <server-address>] [--port <port>]
  portal help

Running without arguments opens the Portal window.
--version and -l (list instances) print their result and exit without opening a window; install / launch run inside the window.
Note: inside install loader, -l is short for --loader; a standalone portal -l means listing instances.

Loaders: fabric / forge / neoforge / quilt / optifine (use @ to specify a version, e.g. fabric@0.16.9)
Modpack: pass a local file, direct link, or a Modrinth / CurseForge project name, slug, or project ID;
       when --version is not given, the latest version is installed (--version is a Modrinth version ID/version number or a CurseForge fileId; --file is equivalent).
Folder: the name or path of a Minecraft folder already added in the launcher; when omitted, the default (first) folder is used.
When launching without a folder, the first instance matching that instance ID is launched.
World: --world takes the folder name of a world under the saves directory; the game enters that world directly after launch (worlds with the same name are distinguished by folder name).
Server: --server takes the server address and --port takes the port (default 25565); the game joins that server directly after launch.
--world and --server are mutually exclusive.

Equivalent portal:// protocol forms (can be called directly from a browser after registration):
  portal://install/vanilla?version=1.21.8&folder=B&id=my-1.21.8
  portal://install/loader?version=1.21.8&loader=fabric&loader=optifine
  portal://install/modpack?source=fabulously-optimized&from=modrinth&version=cZY3Bvs9
  portal://install/modpack?source=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%2Fpack.mrpack&folder=B
  portal://launch?id=26.2&folder=B
  portal://launch?id=26.2&folder=B&world=New%20World
  portal://launch?id=26.2&folder=B&server=play.example.com&port=25565
